metadata.remarks: Secure Container Platform is a composite pattern asserting that container execution, runtime isolation, and supply-chain integrity requirements are collectively satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for use in solution patterns and system security and privacy plans.
